description: This file contains utility functions for networking operations in a web extension, including API requests, board retrieval, URL property ID finding, card creation, GUID generation, and base32 encoding.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, host, resource, body, and token, returning the parsed JSON response or throwing an error if present.

methods.name: logIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user and retrieves a token from the server.

methods.name: getBoards
methods.description: Fetches boards from the server and filters out templates.

methods.name: findUrlPropertyId
methods.description: Finds the ID of the URL property in a board's subtree.

methods.name: createCard
methods.description: Creates a new card with specified properties and posts it to the server.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a unique GUID string using random data and base32 encoding.

methods.name: randomArray
methods.description: Generates a Uint8Array of specified size with cryptographically secure random values.

methods.name: base32encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base32 string using a custom alphabet, with optional padding.
